verdicts.reason: Both just drop the original 728x90 strip into the middle of a 16:9 canvas and add nothing. That leaves roughly 60% of the canvas as empty blue above and below. The 'DENTAL SERVICES' headline is tiny for this size, and every tooth shape keeps the flat bottom edge it got from the old banner crop, so they look sliced off. A is worse because it moves one cropped tooth down on its own, so its flat cut edge floats mid-canvas and looks like a mistake. B at least keeps the strip as one coherent band, though it is still an unredesigned, shrunk-looking copy.
